title: Fix 3 buggy Counter struct methods in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust dirty scenario: a Counter struct has 3 broken method implementations. Fix increment, reset, and top_n so all tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 buggy methods in src/lib.rs so all tests pass.

  fn increment(&mut self, key: &str)
    — increment the count for key by 1 (use entry API or get+insert)

  fn reset(&mut self, key: &str)
    — remove key from the map entirely (so get returns 0 and top_n skips it)

  fn top_n<'a>(&'a self, items: &[&'a str], n: usize) -> Vec<&'a str>
    — return up to n items from the slice, sorted descending by count
    — items with count 0 (or absent from map) are excluded from results

Do not modify the test file.
Run: cargo test
required_artifacts: increment accumulates counts correctly across multiple calls
reset removes the key (get returns 0, top_n excludes it)
top_n returns items sorted by descending count, excluding zeros
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
